facts.fact: The shared admission ticket covers the Main Building, CraftArt/AsianArt Galleries and Torajiro Kojima Memorial Hall; the Annex is under long-term closure.
facts.excerpt: （本館/工芸・東洋館/児島虎次郎記念館　共通）

facts.fact: December–February hours are shorter than March–November and Memorial Hall hours differ from the main museum; check the exact venue/date.
Monday is the normal closed day, with public-holiday exceptions and possible temporary closures; use the current operator calendar.
facts.excerpt: 休館日：毎週月曜日・臨時休館あり

facts.fact: Each building stamps entry; an unused building may be visited another day, while ordinary reentry into the same building is not allowed.
facts.excerpt: ※原則として、同じ館への再入館はできません

facts.fact: Photography is not ordinarily permitted in exhibition rooms; museum rules, staff and temporary exceptions determine any permission.
facts.excerpt: 写真撮影はご遠慮ください。

facts.fact: The museum offers luggage storage, wheelchair and stroller loans, but limited equipment is not a guarantee that every route is stepfree.
